objective.text: The objectives of this investigation were to determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity.
objective.quote: The objectives of this investigation were to: (1) determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity

fuel.text: The sample material for Saffire-I is a composite fabric called Sibal consisting of cotton on a fiberglass substrate.
fuel.quote: The sample material for Saffire-I is a composite fabric called Sibal consisting of cotton on a fiberglass substrate

sample_geometry.text: The sample was approximately 0.94 meters long and 0.4 meters wide.
sample_geometry.quote: The sample was approximately 0.94 meters long and 0.4 meters wide, simulating a large piece of flammable fabric.

flow.text: Saffire-I was conducted at an air flow velocity of 20 cm/s.
flow.quote: Saffire-I was conducted at an air flow velocity of 20 cm/s.

measurements.text: Once the sample was ignited flame images were captured using two cameras.
measurements.quote: Once the sample was ignited flame images were captured using two cameras.

safety_finding.text: The investigation is crucial for the safety of current and future space missions.
safety_finding.quote: The investigation is crucial for the safety of current and future space missions.

earth_benefits.text: Studying fire in small, sealed environments such as the Cygnus cargo supply vehicle benefits fire safety and prevention efforts on Earth, including inside mines, airplanes, or submarines.
earth_benefits.quote: Studying fire in small, sealed environments such as the Cygnus cargo supply vehicle benefits fire safety and prevention efforts on Earth, including inside mines, airplanes, or submarines.
